title: Design System: techbold AI Service Desk

display.purpose: Page-level titles and section anchors only. Barlow Condensed 900 is the web-safe stand-in for ProximaNova Condensed Black used on techbold.at.

headline.purpose: Card titles, ticket subject lines, panel headers.

body.purpose: Ticket descriptions, AI reasoning, activity log prose. Inter approximates Denim WD from techbold.at.

label.purpose: Uppercase labels: nav items, button text, status badges, field labels. Mirrors techbold's live site uppercase CTA convention exactly.

mono.purpose: All shell commands, SSH output, log entries, command proposals. Never on warm surfaces using dark terminal background — use warm-surface (#f3f2ea) background.

shadows.name: lift
shadows.purpose: Hover state on interactive cards. Confirms clickability.

shadows.name: modal
shadows.purpose: Full modal overlays. Derived from navy, not generic black.

motion.name: ease-standard
motion.purpose: Default easing for state transitions (button hover, badge change).

motion.name: ease-out-fast
motion.purpose: Dropdown open, panel slide-in. Fast exit feels snappy.

motion.name: duration-short
motion.purpose: Button hover, focus ring, badge state change.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Main action button. Navy background, no radius, uppercase label font. Gold on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #373652; color: #fff; padding: 13px 29px; border: none; border-radius: 0; font-family: 'Inter', Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.05em; text-transform: uppercase; cursor: pointer; transition: background 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #fcb514; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #fcb514; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { background: #262b4b; }

components.name: Gold CTA Button
components.description: Highest-priority CTA (Submit Activity). Gold background with navy text.
components.css: .ds-btn-gold { background: #fcb514; color: #262b4b; padding: 13px 29px; border: none; border-radius: 0; font-family: 'Inter', Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.05em; text-transform: uppercase; cursor: pointer; transition: background 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1); } .ds-btn-gold:hover { background: #f7cf42; } .ds-btn-gold:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #262b4b; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Secondary action (Edit). Outline style, no fill.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { background: transparent; color: #262b4b; padding: 12px 28px; border: 1px solid #373652; border-radius: 0; font-family: 'Inter', Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.05em; text-transform: uppercase; cursor: pointer; transition: background 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1), color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1); } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: #373652; color: #fff; } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #fcb514; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Status Badge — OPEN
components.description: Ticket status badge for open/active incidents. Gold background signals urgency.
components.css: .ds-badge { display: inline-block; font-family: 'Inter', Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.05em; text-transform: uppercase; padding: 3px 8px; border-radius: 2px; line-height: 1; } .ds-badge-open { background: #fcb514; color: #262b4b; } .ds-badge-pending { background: #373652; color: #ffffff; } .ds-badge-done { background: #262b4b; color: #ffffff; }

components.name: Ticket Card
components.description: List-view card for a service desk ticket. Selected state gets gold left border.
components.html:
OPEN#7001
Nginx not responding on customer VM
Acme Corp · High Priority
components.css: .ds-ticket-card { background: #ffffff; border: 1px solid #e5e7ea; border-radius: 4px; padding: 16px; cursor: pointer; transition: box-shadow 200ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1), border-color 200ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1); } .ds-ticket-card:hover { box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(38,43,75,0.12); border-color: #dadada; } .ds-ticket-card.is-selected { border-left: 4px solid #fcb514; padding-left: 12px; } .ds-ticket-card__header { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; margin-bottom: 8px; } .ds-ticket-card__id { font-family: 'Inter', Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 700; color: #808080; letter-spacing: 0.05em; } .ds-ticket-card__title { font-family: 'Inter', Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 600; color: #262b4b; line-height: 1.3; margin-bottom: 6px; } .ds-ticket-card__meta { font-family: 'Inter', Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 400; color: #808080; }

components.name: Command Approval Panel
components.description: The human-in-the-loop core. Shows AI-proposed shell command with approve/edit/reject actions. Gold left accent border while pending.
components.html:
AI PROPOSAL
sudo systemctl restart nginx

Nginx process is not running. Restarting the service should restore the customer's web endpoint without modifying any configuration.
components.css: .ds-cmd-panel { background: #ffffff; border: 1px solid #e5e7ea; border-left: 4px solid #fcb514; border-radius: 4px; padding: 20px 24px; } .ds-cmd-panel__header { margin-bottom: 12px; } .ds-cmd-panel__command { background: #f3f2ea; border: 1px solid #dadada; border-radius: 2px; padding: 12px 16px; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', 'Courier New', monospace; font-size: 0.875rem; color: #262b4b; line-height: 1.6; margin: 0 0 14px; white-space: pre-wrap; word-break: break-all; } .ds-cmd-panel__reason { font-family: 'Inter', Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 0.9375rem; color: #373652; line-height: 1.5; margin: 0 0 20px; max-width: 72ch; } .ds-cmd-panel__actions { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; } .ds-cmd-panel__reject { background: none; border: none; font-family: 'Inter', Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; color: #808080; cursor: pointer; padding: 4px 0; text-decoration: underline; } .ds-cmd-panel__reject:hover { color: #c0392b; }

components.name: Log Viewer
components.description: Scrollable command execution log. Mono font, warm-surface background. Not a dark terminal.
components.html:
10:04:31$ sudo systemctl restart nginx
10:04:32Synchronizing state of nginx.service with SysV service script...
10:04:33Active: active (running)
components.css: .ds-log { background: #f3f2ea; border: 1px solid #dadada; border-radius: 4px; padding: 16px; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', 'Courier New', monospace; font-size: 0.8125rem; line-height: 1.6; overflow-y: auto; max-height: 400px; } .ds-log__line { display: flex; gap: 16px; padding: 2px 0; } .ds-log__ts { color: #808080; flex-shrink: 0; user-select: none; } .ds-log__cmd { color: #262b4b; font-weight: 600; } .ds-log__out { color: #373652; } .ds-log__err { color: #c0392b; }

components.name: Top Navigation
components.description: Primary navigation bar. Deep navy background, white logo and text, gold hover underline.
components.html:
techbold
  • TICKETS
  • ACTIVITY LOG
  • SETTINGS
components.css: .ds-nav { background: #262b4b; display: flex; align-items: center; padding: 0 24px; height: 56px; gap: 32px; } .ds-nav__brand { font-family: 'Barlow Condensed', 'Arial Narrow', Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 1.25rem; font-weight: 900; color: #ffffff; letter-spacing: -0.02em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-nav__links { display: flex; gap: 0; list-style: none; margin: 0; padding: 0; height: 100%; } .ds-nav__link { display: flex; align-items: center; padding: 0 16px; font-family: 'Inter', Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.05em; text-transform: uppercase; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.75); text-decoration: none; border-bottom: 3px solid transparent; transition: color 150ms, border-color 150ms, background 150ms; height: 100%; } .ds-nav__link:hover { color: #ffffff; background: rgba(252,181,20,0.15); border-bottom-color: #fcb514; } .ds-nav__link--active { color: #ffffff; border-bottom-color: #fcb514; }

components.name: Input Field
components.description: Standard text input. Navy focus border, no glow.
components.css: .ds-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; } .ds-field__label { font-family: 'Inter', Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.05em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #373652; } .ds-field__input { background: #ffffff; border: 1px solid #dadada; border-radius: 4px; padding: 10px 14px; font-family: 'Inter', Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 400; color: #262b4b; line-height: 1.5; transition: border-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1); outline: none; } .ds-field__input::placeholder { color: #808080; } .ds-field__input:focus { border-color: #262b4b; } .ds-field__input:disabled { background: #fbfbfb; border-color: #dadada; color: #808080; cursor: not-allowed; }

narrative.overview:
This is a precision instrument, not a dashboard. Every screen exists to help a trained professional solve a live incident faster and with more confidence. The design draws directly from techbold's established brand: deep navy anchors the structure, amber gold marks what demands attention, and sharp edges signal authority. Nothing decorative. Nothing that makes the technician hunt for the next action.

The system rejects the generic SaaS-admin look — the light-gray-everything, brand-agnostic 'tool' that could belong to any company. This workspace belongs visibly to techbold. It also rejects the hacker-terminal cliché: black backgrounds and green monospace are atmosphere, not usability. The visual logic here is corporate precision: a Bloomberg terminal meets the techbold brand standards guide.

The AI is a participant, not the hero. It proposes; the technician decides. The visual hierarchy enforces this — human actions are primary, AI output is clearly labeled and secondary until the technician acts on it.
keyCharacteristics: Navy-and-gold chromatics from techbold's live website, exact values
Uppercase labels and CTAs, tight tracking
Monospace font for all shell output, commands, and logs
Gold used sparingly as a signal color, never as background texture

rules.name: The Gold-Is-Signal Rule
rules.body: Gold appears on 15% or less of any screen. When gold is on screen, it is pointing at something — a status, an action, a live state. If gold is everywhere, the signal is gone. Ration it.

rules.name: The Navy-as-Structure Rule
rules.body: Deep navy (#262b4b) belongs on structural, non-interactive surfaces (nav bar, sidebar top, section headers). The mid-navy (#373652) belongs on interactive elements (buttons, toggles). Do not invert these.

rules.name: The Uppercase-Is-a-Label Rule
rules.body: Uppercase text is reserved for labels: nav items, button text, status badges, field labels. Body copy, ticket descriptions, and AI output are always sentence case.

rules.name: The Flat-at-Rest Rule
rules.body: Shadows are state, not style. An element at rest is flat; it lifts on hover or when it floats above the document. If you find yourself adding a shadow to a resting card 'to give it depth,' use a 1px solid #e5e7ea border instead.

dos: Do use #262b4b (deep navy) as the structural anchor — top nav, sidebar headers, the dominant dark surface
Do use #fcb514 (gold) to mark what is active, selected, or demanding attention — and then stop
Do use border-radius: 0 on all buttons; use 4px on cards and inputs — the mix is intentional
Do use uppercase + 0.05em tracking for all label text: nav items, button labels, status badges, field labels
Do render all shell commands and SSH output in JetBrains Mono on the warm-surface background (#f3f2ea)
Do keep body text at a maximum 72ch line length in any reading context
Do pair gold backgrounds with navy text only — never gold text on white (fails contrast)
Do label every AI output clearly: 'AI Proposal', 'AI Reasoning', 'AI Generated' in the label style
Do make the Approve / Edit / Reject triad the most prominent element when a command is pending
Do include @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) alternatives for all transitions
donts: Don't use a dark or black terminal background anywhere in the UI — this is a branded corporate tool, not a hacker interface
Don't use gold (#fcb514) as body text color on white or light backgrounds — contrast fails WCAG AA
Don't use border-radius greater than 12px on any element — the brand language is sharp
Don't add gradients — background fills are solid; techbold's site uses no gradients
Don't use purple, neon, or glow effects — wrong register for a professional IT firm
Don't make the AI the hero — the AI proposes, the technician decides; never style AI output more prominently than human actions
Don't use glassmorphism or frosted glass effects — off-brand
Don't scatter gold across every section as decoration; the Gold-Is-Signal Rule makes each appearance matter
Don't use consumer chat-interface patterns (bubble messages, avatar + text rows) for the AI interaction
